description: Update a diagram: rename it, replace its Mermaid source entirely, change its theme or Global Settings, or set its node overrides. Only fields you pass change — to edit the diagram's content, pass the complete new `code`, not a fragment. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

code.description: Full replacement Mermaid source — this tool rewrites the whole diagram, not a patch to one node.

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

node_overrides.description: Per-node drag position/color overrides, keyed by node id — as the editor itself stores them.

theme_id.description: One of the Diagram Maker theme ids, e.g. "minimal-flat", "dark-console", "neon", "cartoon". Omit to keep the current theme.

name: update_diagram
